otpInput.$description: v0.7 — Cell-row pattern for one-time passcodes. Each cell is its own .lumen-field micro-shell so each cell has independent focus state. Row gap and per-cell width are owned here; surface/border/ring come from input.*.

value.$description: Each digit renders mono, centered, slightly larger than body for legibility.

groupSep.$description: Optional wider gap between 3-3 grouped cells (e.g. 123 456).
